question: Which of the following sentences contains the meaning of the word 'listless'?

options.text: As soon as Ravi reported for duty, he was asked to present himself for roster call.
To apply for a passport, a list of documents is to be submitted.
Rudresh is good at creating a linearly ordered data structure on his computer.
After listening to a long speech, Tanuja felt exhausted and devoid of energy.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"listless"** means lacking energy or enthusiasm; feeling tired, sluggish, or indifferent. (ऊर्जाहीन, उदासीन)

 
 
• **Example:** After staying awake all night, she felt too listless to focus on her work.
 
 
 
• The correct word here is **"exhausted"**, which means completely drained of energy or strength. (थका हुआ, ऊर्जा विहीन)
